test_qualify_window_filtering: test the QUALIFY clause filters rows after window functions like AVG and MAX partitioned by category
test_qualify_distinct_with_window: test QUALIFY clause combined with DISTINCT to select rows matching window function conditions
test_qualify_aggregate_windows: test QUALIFY with aggregate window functions like SUM and COUNT partitioned by category
test_qualify_multiple_conditions: test QUALIFY with multiple conditions combined using AND and OR operators
test_qualify_select_alias: test QUALIFY clause referencing column aliases defined in the SELECT clause
